acceptanceCriteria: A fixture with a compose env_file, a .env file and a workflow env block contributes each variable with its source cited.
A WireMock mapping and one Go/Flask/Rails stand-in route appear in the stand-in catalog, or each unsupported framework has a named abstention.
`tests validity` lists env-contract warnings for an affected test; `corvint impact` lists tests affected by a bootstrap offset change.
body: Residuals of V1-1940 (#1199, PR #1205, head e651576cf, TSA-V0-200..216): the test-process environment contract reads only the sources implemented there. Missing: (1) docker compose `environment`/`env_file`, dotenv files and CI workflow `env` blocks as variable sources; (2) stand-in control routes for Go, Flask, Rails and WireMock servers; (3) env-contract warnings are not shown in the `corvint tests validity` projection; (4) bootstrap-change impact is not shown in `corvint impact`. Related: V1-1941 (#1200 request-path keys).
title: Env contract: read compose, dotenv and CI workflow environments and non-JS stand-in routes; surface warnings in tests validity and impact
